summary: After an in-session record_delivery or accept_worker_result exit the submitting session sits inside the authorship set, so CD-0013 D5 refuses its verdict and no in-session distinct evaluator exists. record_verdict and complete then accept the operator's signed identity (the confirm_premise mechanism), stamped as the verdict actor, conditioned on either exit completion; every other state keeps CD-0109's distinct-actor rule, and the agent surface mints the operator challenge exactly for the lease-holding session.
title: the operator signs the verdict after an in-session delivery
